[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips to improve dancing skills, including:
1. Practice regularly (2-3 times a week).
2. Focus on technique.
3. Listen to the music.
4. Break down complex moves.
5. Take classes from different instructors.
6. Practice with a partner.
7. Watch and learn from others.
8. Set goals and track progress.
9. Stay relaxed and have fun.
10. Take care of your body.
